Idle is the space you’ve always wanted to gather, connect, and actually do things together. Own your weird little space! This isn’t a channel in someone else’s app. Get your own address, fill it with your stuff, even charge rent. your .idle.space Your Domain Every space has an address people can find. This one shouldn’t be any different Widget Tiles Lil’ apps that interact with your chat and make your space useful and fun Paid Spaces Coming Soon Create a members-only space and automate membership. Make a space worth building Make your space useful Add widgets to your space and help everyone do things. Widgets live in their own drawer next to your chat so they can never get lost with the stream.
